question: Which of the following festivals is associated with Rajasthan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bundi Utsav**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The two-day Bundi Utsav began on 22 November 2021 in Bundi, Rajasthan.
 
• It is being jointly organized by the State Tourism Department and District Administration after two years.
 
• A variety of folk events will be presented by popular artist groups.
